thread:
Maya: heads-up — noticed a small cluster of tenants getting routed back to v1 during quota spikes because their client tokens are still pinned to older affinity keys. this causes higher latency for them and makes us pay more on dedicated pools. want to propose an unpin/unwind UX + telemetry changes. :eyes:

Jack: can you paste a quick log/repro? is this deterministic or intermittent?

Maya: intermittent but reproducible on staging. sample decision log:```json
{
  "tenant": "acct-42",
  "client_version": "v2",
  "pinned_version": "v1",
  "route_decision": "v1",
  "reason": "affinity_pin",
  "quota_state": "spike"
}```

Sasha: ok — two issues: 1) console/dashboard doesn't show pinned_version per-tenant in the last-24h panel, 2) our telemetry doesn't emit an explicit unpin event so we can't audit auto-unpins. we need new signals.

Olivia: from an ops/UX angle I'd like a short-lived override in the console: a tenant-admin can "temporarily unpin" for X minutes (default 10) with a modal that shows estimated cost impact and an audit entry. minimal scope for first iteration. example modal copy: "Unpin routing for 10 minutes — requests may switch to newer model variants. Estimated change: +0.3 tokens/response. Confirm?"

Jack: safety question — if we unpin, could that push traffic onto a constrained v2 pool and cause cascading failures? we need pre-checks. maybe disallow unpin if v2(util) > 95% or if model variant is incompatible.

Maya: agree. propose flow: 1) console triggers a pre-flight check (capacity estimate + compatibility), 2) if safe, emit a version_unpin_request event and run a quick rollout to 5% shadow, 3) if success, apply unpin for TTL. if pre-flight fails, show reason and offer to open a support ticket.

Sasha: telemetry requirements (minimal): - emit event version_unpin_request {tenant, requester, requested_ttl, preflight_passed, estimated_cost_delta} - emit event version_unpin_result {tenant, result: allowed|blocked|rolled_back, reason_code} - add gauge pinned_version per tenant to per-route metrics

Olivia: console bits: - button in tenant detail: "Temporarily unpin routing" - confirmation modal with cost delta and capacity warning - audit log row and email alert opt-in for tenant admin

Jack: implementation notes: need API route /admin/tenants/:id/unpin that only platform admins + tenant-admins can call. DB: add field temporary_unpin_until and last_unpin_reason. We should also ensure the routing layer prefers explicit tenant_admin_flag over affinity cache. pseudocode:```py
if now < tenant.temporary_unpin_until:
  route_to(newest_compatible_version)
else:
  continue_with_affinity_pin()
```

Maya: + deploy-bot — any canary running that intersects?

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started — feature-flag: tenant-temporary-unpin v1 -> rollout cohorts: 10% infra / 5% tenants.

Sasha: sampling/taxonomy: unify reason_code ontology for telemetry (quota_spike, admin_override, auto_unpin_policy, manual_unpin). will add to spec. also recommend sampling unpin events at 100% for 24h after launch then 5% afterwards.

Jack: what about billing/quotas? if unpin causes higher tokens, tenants should see an estimated cost bump and a throttling fallback if they exceed quota. tie into per-tenant quota-meter.

Olivia: UX: show a toaster when unpin starts and when it ends. also show a small badge in tenant dashboard: "Routing: unpinned (10m) — cost +0.3/req"

Maya: action items: - Sasha: telemetry event schemas + sampling plan (EOD tomorrow) - Jack: API + routing change PR (small DB migration) — aim alpha by Thu - Olivia: modal copy + console mockups — aim Wed - Maya: add runbook note for SRE about capacity preflight thresholds (proposed 95%)

Jack: fine by me. :+1:

Sasha: will also add a dashboard tile showing "unpin requests / failures" to monitor regressions.

Olivia: add me to the PR review for the modal and copy.

Maya: thanks — I'll open the umbrella ticket and link the specs. leaving this thread for the action items. :slightly_smiling_face:
